verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file at developers.heap.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and a markdown docs index at /docs.md. The doc pages are also served as .md files (e.g. web.md, api-reference.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: any first-party documentation describing agent-oriented usage or llms-full.txt, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
